tools.name: creator_desk_verify_completion
tools.description: Use when you have a storefront URL and supplied evidence and need a readiness verdict, defects, corrective actions, and an evidence receipt.

tools.name: creator_desk_inspect_url
tools.description: Use when you have a public HTTPS URL and need its HTTP status, redirects, latency, security headers, and page metadata.

tools.name: creator_desk_extract_page
tools.description: Use when you have a public HTTPS HTML page URL and need clean Markdown and page metadata.

tools.name: creator_desk_lookup_dns
tools.description: Use when you have a public DNS hostname and optional record type and need the matching DNS records and lookup status.

tools.name: creator_desk_check_broken_links
tools.description: Use when you have up to 20 public HTTPS URLs and need per-link status, redirects, latency, and broken-link results.

tools.name: creator_desk_agent_preflight
tools.description: Use when you have a public HTTPS agent origin and need an A2A and x402 readiness verdict with surface checks.

tools.name: creator_desk_word_count
tools.description: Use when you have optional plain text and need its word count or a deterministic payment canary result.

tools.name: creator_desk_machine_distribution_offers
tools.description: Use when you need Creator Desk Machine Distribution pricing, its service page and available checkout or x402 links.

tools.name: creator_desk_machine_acquisition_offers
tools.description: Use when you need Creator Desk Machine Acquisition Network pricing, its service page and available checkout or x402 links.

tools.name: creator_desk_machine_router_offers
tools.description: Use when you need Creator Desk Machine Marketplace Router pricing, its service page and available checkout or x402 links.
